youtube.title: Why Is Milk Always at the Back of the Store? (Since 1916)
youtube.description:
You only wanted a gallon of milk, so why is it at the very back of the store? Grocers say it's the cold room and the delivery dock, and that's true, but it isn't the whole story. In 1916 Clarence Saunders patented a store that walked every shopper past every shelf, the 1937 shopping cart made that walk pay, and when the milkman vanished, milk became the bait at the end of it. The Hidden Why tells the true story behind the things you use every day. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
